pairs.source_text: SET @SQL = N'INSERT #CurrentValue (CurrentValue) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(' + QUOTENAME(@ColumnName) + N'), 0) FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@SchemaName) + N'.' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + N';';
